title: cooldowns
summary: MSUI implements the complete current Benilla cooldown family without changing protected action-bar presentation: append-only spell-history nodes keep cast-send GCD and later GO recovery independent; queries resolve spell/item pairs, category and wildcard-category clocks, and GCD-category equality by longest remaining. The current ranged-weapon-speed pad, Attack/trade-skill head exclusion, item-authored local recovery, login/pet seeds, addressed server overrides, on-event parking/release, per-spell/GCD clears, cheat wipe, and existing CooldownFrame finish flash are all wired. Focused and full interface checks pass; live server verification remains.

openItems.text: SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT unhandled and no on_hold state: SPELL_ATTR_COOLDOWN_ON_EVENT spells (Stealth, Feign Death) should park their recovery until the event packet starts it - MSUI starts them at cast time (wrong start) and ignores the packet.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: SpellInfo exposes the on-event attribute, cast completion parks rather than runs those records, and SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT starts the held duration at receive time. Focused state checks pin the transition.

openItems.text: SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN unhandled: a server-side cooldown clear leaves the client clock running - the button stays visually dark until it expires on its own.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict spell-first/raw-guid SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN decoding clears the spell, its owned category recovery, and any held record from the addressed player or pet store.

openItems.text: SMSG_ITEM_COOLDOWN unhandled and records are keyed by spell id only (no cast-item id pair): item-use cooldowns pushed at login/on-use are not reflected.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict raw-item-guid/u32-spell decoding resolves the live item entity and starts the item-use recovery in the addressed player cooldown store.
2026-08-22: strict raw-guid SMSG_COOLDOWN_CHEAT decoding clears every running and held record for the addressed player or pet.

openItems.text: Current Benilla's append-only SpellHistory law, item/spell pair identity, GCD-category getter, wildcard category, ranged-weapon pad, and cooldown-query head exclusion were absent from the older MSUI cooldown registry snapshot.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: replaced overwrite dictionaries and blanket GCD gating with append-only independent recovery/category/GCD records; wired current cast, item, packet, pet, display, and refusal consumers; focused and full interface suites pass.

openItems.text: Live verification: exercise an on-event spell, item cooldown, server clear, and cooldown-cheat clear on player and pet stores; confirm action buttons start/park/clear at the server-authored moments and finish flashes occur once.
